A_RHom_Zhat_Q_zero.desc: RHom(Zhat,Q)=0 via vanishing finite shadows: Hom(Z/N,Q)=0 (Q torsion-free), Ext^1(Z/N,Q)=Q/NQ=0 (Q divisible)

B_pairing_degree.desc: dim_Q Hom(eps (x) eps, Z[m]) = dim_Q Ext^{m-1}_Solid(eps,Q); =Q iff m=2

table.note: PROPOSED target Z[-1]: ONLY zero pairing

C_adele_generator.desc: Ext^1_Solid(eps,Q)=Q generated by the finite-adele class 0->Q->A_f->eps->0 (pushout of 0->Z->Zhat->eps->0 along Z->Q); CRT shadows verified

D_symmetry_sign.desc: self-pairing is a degree-1 (odd) Yoneda class: swap sign (-1)^(1*1)=-1 => ALTERNATING (symplectic type); adjoint eps->Q[1] not iso (degrees 0 vs -1) => DEGENERATE

E_darboux_nogo.desc: StratPro support idempotents e_S act on Zhat but descend to End(eps)=End(Zhat/Z) iff e_S(1)=1_S is a constant CRT vector, iff S in {empty, all-primes}

F_hyperbolic_pairing.desc: finite duality pairing Z/N x Z/N -> Q/Z is perfect (nondegenerate) for N=1..840: eps and Q are complementary Lagrangians of a hyperbolic plane, not an intrinsic symplectic eps
